decision: Implement VD-0004 as static Astro HTML on Workers Static Assets, render the four Home frame examples from published Inset product assets with unique photographs, use inline SVG for the small interface icons, and keep Wrangler as the only required Cloudflare CLI for the initial release.
alternatives: Add SSR and Worker runtime adapters
Install the full optional Cloudflare toolchain immediately
rationale: This preserves verifiable product evidence, avoids repeated photography and unnecessary client payload, and keeps the static launch toolchain proportionate to the architecture.

decision: Use https://inset.page as the canonical production origin, keep the apex on direct Workers Static Assets, and route www.inset.page through a dedicated minimal Worker that preserves path and query in a one-hop 301 to the apex.
alternatives: Serve the static site on both apex and www
Configure a zone Single Redirect through the current read-only API connector
Run all apex asset requests through a shared redirect-aware Worker
rationale: The user selected inset.page. A separate 0.45 KiB redirect Worker is deployable with the existing Wrangler authorization, prevents duplicate content, and preserves direct static-asset delivery on the canonical host after the Single Redirect API rejected the connector's edit permission.
